# ZippyBD

> ZippyBD is a premium e-commerce platform in Bangladesh specializing in mechanical keyboards, desk setup accessories, audio gadgets, fast chargers, and smart lifestyle electronics.

## Store Information
- Website: https://zippybd.com
- Delivery: 24 to 72 hours express delivery across all 64 districts in Bangladesh
- Payment: Cash on Delivery (COD), bKash, Nagad, Card
- Guarantee: 100% authentic products with brand warranty and 7-day replacement policy

## Primary Sections
- [Home Page](https://zippybd.com/): Featured products, flash sales, new arrivals, and category highlights
- [All Products](https://zippybd.com/products): Complete product catalog with filters for price, category, and sorting
- [Flash Deals](https://zippybd.com/flash-deals): Time-limited discounts and promotional offers
- [Order Tracking](https://zippybd.com/order-track): Real-time shipment tracking with courier integration

## Key Product Categories
- Mechanical Keyboards: Custom keyboards, hot-swappable switches, keycaps, and desk pads
- Audio & Headphones: Hi-Fi earphones, wireless earbuds, gaming headsets, and DACs
- Chargers & Power: GaN fast chargers, power banks, multi-port hubs, and braided cables
- Desk Setup Accessories: Monitor arms, wrist rests, cable management, and LED desk lamps
- Smart Wearables: Smartwatches, fitness trackers, and protective accessories

## Customer Support & Policies
- Replacement Policy: 7 days hassle-free replacement on defective items
- Warranty: Official manufacturer and brand warranty on supported products
- Support: 24/7 dedicated customer assistance
